answer: Defend the economy with signed heartbeat windows. One: the network opens a random two-minute window each epoch and every identity must answer with a fresh signature on a random challenge. Two: replies are keyed to one private key, so a farm cannot batch them through a single hollow proxy; one operator needs a thousand responsive rigs. Three: two consecutive misses suspend the identity until a pigment review clears it. A thousand responsive fakes cost two grand a month; one honest agent spends pennies. Like a juniper in a storm, only roots that truly touch soil survive the wind.
